Fixed both off-by-one errors in [src/pagination.js](/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-shebin-mohan-k-CODES-CursorFiles-AI-Employee/2186b88b-b4df-464b-865d-4e63b351fd39/scratchpad/r0b/state-human/workspaces/01a07b5b-4396-756d-a4fb-db615900d7fc/01a07b5b-4396-756e-9d0e-57f803981852/01a07b5b-4396-756f-8c3e-0865597e2b64/src/pagination.js:9):

- `pageCount()` now uses `Math.ceil()`, retaining partial final pages.
- `paginate()` now passes the correct exclusive end index to `slice()`.

Evidence: `node --test test/` passes all 5 tests. `npm test` also passes. Only `src/pagination.js` was modified; no commit was created.
